subject: DI01000091

body.en:
Understand the idea

Scratch is a graphical programming environment where connected blocks define executable behaviour.

Explanation and application

  • An algorithm is a finite,clear plan for a task;blocks are its implementation,not just a decorative picture.
  • Sequence,events,conditions,loops and data can create animations,calculations and games.
  • Save editable .sb3 projects and test actual behaviour;these notes provide native .sb3 teaching projects for practicals13–35,not C/Python substitutes.
Are Scratch sin inputs in radians?

No.Scratch trigonometric blocks use degrees.
body.gu:
વિચાર સમજીએ

Scratch graphical programming environment છે;connected blocks executable behaviour નક્કી કરે છે.

સમજણ અને ઉપયોગ

  • Algorithm task માટે finite clear plan છે;blocks તેનો implementation છે,decorative picture નહિ.
  • Sequence,events,conditions,loops/dataથી animations,calculations/games બનાવી શકાય.
  • Editable .sb3 save કરીને behaviour test કરો.અહીં practicals13–35 માટે native .sb3 teaching projects છે,C/Python substitutes નહિ.
Scratch sinમાં Radians છે?

ના.Scratch trigonometric blocks degrees લે છે.

h.en: Know which sprite you are editing
h.gu: કયો Sprite Edit કરો છો તે જાણો

body.en:
Understand the idea

The editor separates stage,actors,code and assets so the same event can drive several independent scripts.

Explanation and application

  • The stage shows backdrops and sprite output;the sprite list selects the actor and sprite info sets position,size,direction and visibility-related state.
  • Blocks tab/palette supplies blocks;the scripts/code area stores connected stacks.The toolbar provides project and run/stop controls.
  • Costumes change sprite appearance;Sounds stores audio assets.Backdrops belong to the stage.A selected stage does not offer every sprite motion command.
body.gu:
વિચાર સમજીએ

Editor stage,actors,code/assets જુદા રાખે છે;એક event અનેક independent scripts ચલાવી શકે છે.

સમજણ અને ઉપયોગ

  • Stage backdrop/output બતાવે છે.Sprite list actor પસંદ કરે છે;info position,size/direction વગેરે state બતાવે છે.
  • Blocks tab/palette blocks આપે છે;scripts/code area connected stacks રાખે છે.Toolbarમાં project તથા run/stop controls છે.
  • Costumes spriteનો દેખાવ બદલે છે;Sounds audio assets રાખે છે.Backdrops stageના છે.Stage select હોય ત્યારે દરેક sprite motion command મળતો નથી.

body.en:
Understand the idea

Create or edit a costume/backdrop while controlling drawing mode,size and reference centre.

Explanation and application

  • Use selection,shape,brush,fill and text tools deliberately;vector/bitmap editing operations may differ.
  • The costume rotation centre affects rotation and positioning;an off-centre drawing can appear to orbit when the sprite turns.
  • Use the centre crosshair/alignment tools available in your editor and test rotation after editing;keep copies before destructive asset edits.
body.gu:
વિચાર સમજીએ

Drawing mode,size/reference centre સમજતાં costume/backdrop create/edit કરો.

સમજણ અને ઉપયોગ

  • Selection,shape,brush,fill/text tools વિચારીને લો.Vector/bitmap operations જુદાં હોઈ શકે.
  • Costume rotation centre rotation/positionને અસર કરે છે.Off-centre drawing turnએ orbit કરતી દેખાય શકે.
  • Editorમાં available centre crosshair/alignment tools લો તથા rotation test કરો.Destructive asset edits પહેલાં copies રાખો.

h.en: Operators and functions:read the nested expression

body.en:
Understand the idea

Rounded reporter blocks compute values that fit into other block inputs.

Explanation and application

  • Use +,−,*,/ and mod with explicit nesting;guard zero divisors.=2+3*4 from spreadsheets is implemented by nested reporter blocks in Scratch.
  • Mathematical functions include abs,floor,ceiling,sqrt,sin,cos,tan,log and ln where offered;check input domain.Scratch trigonometric functions use degrees.
  • pick random1to6 with integer endpoints models a die outcome with inclusive bounds.It does not guarantee equal counts in a short run and is not a security random source.
  • Example:A=10,theta=30degrees gives A*sin(theta)=5;do not convert to radians before the Scratch sin block.
body.gu:
વિચાર સમજીએ

Rounded reporter blocks values compute કરીને બીજા blocksના inputsમાં fit થાય છે.

સમજણ અને ઉપયોગ

  • +,−,*,/,mod explicit nestingથી લો;zero divisor guard કરો.Spreadsheetનું =2+3*4 Scratchમાં nested reportersથી બને છે.
  • Mathematical functionsમાં offered મુજબ abs,floor,ceiling,sqrt,sin,cos,tan,log/ln છે.Input domain જુઓ.Scratch trigonometric functions degrees લે છે.
  • Integer endpoints સાથે pick random1to6 die outcome model કરે છે;bounds inclusive છે.Short runમાં equal countsની ખાતરી નથી તથા security random source નથી.
  • Example:A=10,theta=30degreesથી A*sin(theta)=5 મળે છે.Scratch sin પહેલાં radians conversion ન કરો.

h.en: Number,string and Boolean are different ideas
h.gu: Number,String તથા Boolean જુદા વિચારો છે

body.en:
Understand the idea

A value may represent a number,text or a true/false condition;Scratch also performs automatic conversions.

Explanation and application

  • answer is user-entered text;validate before arithmetic so blank or nonnumeric input is not silently treated as useful zero.
  • join combines text;arithmetic adds numeric values.Hexagonal comparisons/logical reporters supply conditions.
  • Scratch comparisons can coerce numeric-looking strings and compare text without case sensitivity.Define case,spaces and numeric-string policy before claiming an exact-text algorithm.
body.gu:
વિચાર સમજીએ

Value number,text કે true/false condition બતાવી શકે છે.Scratch automatic conversions પણ કરે છે.

સમજણ અને ઉપયોગ

  • answer user-entered text છે.Arithmetic પહેલાં validate કરો જેથી blank/nonnumeric inputને useful zero ન માનો.
  • join text combine કરે છે;arithmetic numeric values ઉમેરે છે.Hexagonal comparison/logical reporters conditions આપે છે.
  • Scratch comparison numeric-looking strings coerce કરી શકે તથા textમાં case ignore કરે છે.Exact-text algorithm કહેતાં પહેલાં case,spaces/numeric-string policy નક્કી કરો.

h.en: Variables and scope prevent accidental interference
h.gu: Variables તથા Scopeથી Accidental Interference ટાળો

body.en:
Understand the idea

A variable is a named storage location whose value can change while a project runs.

Explanation and application

  • Create a clearly named variable,use set to initialise and change by to accumulate;show/hide controls the monitor,not the existence of the value.
  • For all sprites gives shared state;for this sprite only gives actor-local state.Custom-block inputs supply parameter values and are not the same as arbitrary global variables.
  • Reset totals,counters,pen state and lists on green flag when the task requires a fresh run;test a second run for leftover-state bugs.
Why reset on green flag?

To avoid leftover counters,lists and drawing state on a fresh run.
body.gu:
વિચાર સમજીએ

Variable named storage location છે;project ચાલે ત્યારે value બદલાઈ શકે છે.

સમજણ અને ઉપયોગ

  • Clearly named variable બનાવો.Setથી initialise તથા change byથી accumulate કરો.Show/hide monitorને અસર કરે છે,valueના existenceને નહિ.
  • For all sprites shared state તથા for this sprite only actor-local state આપે છે.Custom-block inputs parameter values છે,arbitrary globals નહિ.
  • Fresh run જરૂરી હોય તો green flagએ totals,counters,pen state/lists reset કરો.Leftover-state bugs માટે second run test કરો.
Green Flagએ Reset કેમ?

Fresh runમાં leftover counters,lists/drawing state ટાળવા.
